title: Emil Michael: Iran, Anthropic and the Future of AI at the Pentagon

thesis: Emil Michael argues that the Department of Defense must shift from 'peacetime speed' to 'wartime speed' to address a historic military build-up and catch up with adversaries who are leveraging AI to eliminate human decision-making. He prioritizes applied AI as the top critical technology priority, noting that within 90 days of his tenure, 1.2 million personnel had adopted AI tools compared to only 80,000 previously, while also identifying risks associated with AI models baked into sensitive military contracts under terms that could shut them off mid-operation.
